ابتهجتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَهَجْتُنَّ (ibtahajtunna) /ib.ta.had͡ʒ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# اُبْتُهِجْتُنَّ (ubtuhijtunna) /ub.tu.hid͡ʒ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
